header.purpose: Rive state machine inputs (number, boolean, trigger) drive placeholders

captions: number, before any play: file's own state, label -
number, picker 3: one play, smallest house
number, picker 6: three more plays, largest house
boolean Start, 1 s after Play all: orbit runs
trigger pullRelease, 1.2 s after Play all
footer: Result: pass. Number: each play sets the next Rooms (3, 4, 5, 6) and the house grows in step; Loop steps it every 1.5 s. Boolean: Start false then true starts the Space reload. Trigger: reset then pullRelease sends the skater back into the box. Method: taps on the emulator, hilog setNumberState / setBooleanState / fireState, unit tests 91 / 91.
